reason: The lifestyle still is the only one that reads as this brand's 8am kitchen: low window light from the right, the copper jug as the single warm accent, a thumbprint-glazed cup and a linen towel on worn oak. The LOWLAND ROASTERS label is legible and straight, and there is calm space above the bag, so a slow push-in will not crop anything that matters.

notes.note: Clean and on-palette, label sharp, beans at the base as briefed. Strong for the product page, but it is a catalog shot with no sense of place, so it is the weaker one to spend a video on.
Label legible, oak and linen read as real surfaces, one copper accent, side light with direction. Best fit to the brief.
Good headline space on the left and the warm wall light is right, but the bag is small in frame and the label's small type softens at that size; strong as a banner, weak as the one asset to animate.
